svg.title: CCR5 genotypes and entry of R5 HIV-1 into human CD4 T cells
svg.desc: Three schematic membrane cutaways compare CCR5/CCR5, CCR5/CCR5-Delta32, and Delta32/Delta32. Spiked enveloped HIV virions contain a conical core. Blue CD4 is present in all three. Green functional surface CCR5 is present in the first two, allowing R5 entry, and absent in the third, blocking R5 entry. The first genotype has infection with normal progression; the heterozygote has infection with delayed progression; the Delta32 homozygote is resistant to R5 HIV-1. Receptor abundance, spike number, and molecular sizes are illustrative. Resistance does not extend to every HIV strain.

g.text: R5 HIV-1 and human CD4 T cells
